body.zh-Hant: 1876年4月10日生於阿爾貝夫（Albeuve），父親是農民兼旅館業者。他在弗里堡、慕尼黑、萊比錫、柏林與維也納修習法學，1904年取得法學博士，1906年取得律師執照；1906至1911年在比勒（Bulle）執業，1911至1912年任格呂耶爾信貸銀行（Crédit gruyérien）董事。
body.en: Born on 10 April 1876 in Albeuve, the son of a farmer and hotelier. He studied law in Fribourg, Munich, Leipzig, Berlin and Vienna, took his doctorate in 1904 and his lawyer's licence in 1906. He practised as a lawyer in Bulle from 1906 to 1911 and was director of the Crédit gruyérien in 1911-1912.

heading.en: Fribourg politics and the National Council

body.zh-Hant: 1911至1919年他任弗里堡大議會議員（HLS 稱其為保守派），1912至1919年任州務委員並主管財政廳，著力整頓州財政；1914至1919年另任聯邦國民院議員，以聯邦主義者、財政專家與反社會主義者的姿態出名。
body.en: From 1911 to 1919 he sat in the Fribourg Grand Council (the HLS calls him a conservative), and from 1912 to 1919 he was a cantonal councillor in charge of finance, working to repair the canton's finances. From 1914 to 1919 he was also a member of the National Council, where he stood out as a federalist, a finance specialist and an anti-socialist.

heading.en: Federal Councillor and head of the finance department

body.zh-Hant: 1919年12月11日他在第一輪投票中當選聯邦委員，主管財政與關稅部門，直到1934年；1925年與1930年出任聯邦主席。他重視整頓聯邦財政與維持法郎穩定，1927年推行含罷工禁令的公務員身分制度。1934年3月他向聯邦委員會發出最後通牒，同僚拒絕他的方案，他於4月30日辭去聯邦委員。
body.en: On 11 December 1919 he was elected to the Federal Council in the first ballot and headed the finance and customs department until 1934; he was Federal President in 1925 and 1930. His main concerns were restoring the federal finances and keeping the franc stable, and in 1927 he introduced civil-service status that carried a strike ban. In March 1934 he gave the Federal Council an ultimatum, his colleagues refused his programme, and he resigned on 30 April 1934.

body.zh-Hant: 1935至1939年他再度任國民院議員，並投身反共團體。州政府頁稱他在二戰期間公開表態支持軸心國；他應一個猶太組織之請，利用與希姆萊的私人關係，促成一個1200名猶太人的車隊入境瑞士。戰後他退出政治，1949年赴伊拉克協助整頓王國財政，1952年4月19日逝世。
body.en: From 1935 to 1939 he again sat in the National Council and was active in anti-communist organisations. The Fribourg government page says that during the Second World War he openly appeared as a supporter of the Axis powers; at the request of a Jewish organisation he used his personal connections with Himmler to enable a convoy of 1,200 Jews to enter Switzerland. After the war he gave up politics, went to Iraq in 1949 to put the kingdom's finances in order, and died on 19 April 1952.

body.zh-Hant: 德拉克魯瓦1867年12月27日生於布魯塞爾近郊的聖若斯滕諾德（Saint-Josse-ten-Noode）。法國國家圖書館的人名權威記錄把他列為比利時人，著述語言為法語，職業為律師與政治人物。
body.en: Léon Delacroix was born on 27 December 1867 in Saint-Josse-ten-Noode near Brussels. The authority record of the Bibliothèque nationale de France lists him as Belgian, writing in French, and describes him as a lawyer and politician.

body.zh-Hant: 1918年11月13日國王接受庫曼（Cooreman）內閣的辭職，隔日（11月14日）指定德拉克魯瓦組閣。庫曼內閣任期止於1918年11月21日；此後德拉克魯瓦自1918年11月起任首相，法國國家圖書館權威記錄並載他同時兼任財政大臣，時間為1918至1920年。
body.en: On 13 November 1918 the King accepted the resignation of the Cooreman cabinet, and the next day, 14 November, he designated Delacroix to form the new government. The Cooreman cabinet lasted until 21 November 1918; Delacroix was prime minister from November 1918, and the BnF authority record adds that he was also finance minister, in 1918-1920.

body.en: The authority record of the German National Library says he was a delegate to the Reparation Commission and trustee for the Reichsbahn bonds. The source cited in the BnF record is the Report of the Trustee for the German Railway Bonds, dated 12 December 1928 and signed by him, and the Library of Congress record lists the same trustee report. He died on 15 October 1929 in Baden-Baden, Germany.

body.zh-Hant: 1891年12月21日生於楚格州的門青根（Menzingen），是桶匠師傅約瑟夫·安東·埃特（Josef Anton Etter）四個孩子中最小的一個。他1907至1911年就讀艾因西德倫的修道院學校，隨後在蘇黎世大學修習法學，1917年取得法學碩士，並取得施維茨州的律師執照。
body.en: Born on 21 December 1891 in Menzingen in the canton of Zug, the youngest of four children of the master cooper Josef Anton Etter. From 1907 to 1911 he attended the Stiftsschule in Einsiedeln, then studied law at the University of Zurich, taking his licentiate in 1917, and obtained the Schwyz lawyer's licence.

body.zh-Hant: 他1912至1934年任《楚格新聞》（Zuger Nachrichten）總編輯，1918年成為保守人民黨（KVP）的州議會議員。1923至1934年他進入楚格州政府，掌管教育與軍事廳；1930至1934年並任聯邦院（Ständerat）議員。
body.en: From 1912 to 1934 he was chief editor of the Zuger Nachrichten, and in 1918 he became a cantonal parliament member of the Conservative People's Party (KVP). From 1923 to 1934 he sat in the Zug cantonal government, running the education and military directorates, and from 1930 to 1934 he was also a member of the Council of States.

heading.zh-Hant: 當選聯邦委員與精神國防
heading.en: Federal Councillor and spiritual national defence

body.zh-Hant: 1934年3月28日，他在第一輪投票中以115票當選聯邦委員，接掌內政部，此後任期長達25年。他是所謂「精神國防」（Geistige Landesverteidigung）的主要推手之一；1939年創立的文化基金會 Pro Helvetia 即屬這一路線，他並在1939年以聯邦主席身分參與塑造全國的「國博精神」（Landigeist）。
body.en: On 28 March 1934 he was elected to the Federal Council in the first ballot with 115 votes and took over the Department of the Interior, which he headed for a term of 25 years. He was a leading figure in developing the so-called spiritual national defence; Pro Helvetia was founded in 1939, and as Federal President that year he helped shape the national 'Landi spirit'.

citations.quote: am 28. März 1934 im ersten Wahlgang mit 115 Stimmen
in den Bundesrat gewählt

während seiner 25-jährigen Amtszeit an Bedeutung gewann
Entwicklung der sogenannten Geistigen Landesverteidigung beteiligt

Als Bundespräsident prägte Etter 1939 den nationalen «Landigeist» mit

body.zh-Hant: 二戰期間他與聯邦委員會全體對軸心國採取格外謹慎的政策。戰後他主管的事務包括創立瑞士國家基金會與引入殘障保險（IV）；他在1939、1942、1947與1953年擔任聯邦主席。1959年他辭職，使「魔法公式」得以實施。
body.en: During the Second World War he followed, with the whole Federal Council, an especially cautious policy towards the Axis powers. After the war his responsibilities included the founding of the Swiss National Science Foundation and the introduction of disability insurance (IV); he was Federal President in 1939, 1942, 1947 and 1953. In 1959 his resignation made the introduction of the 'magic formula' possible.
